title: Aged Care (Living Longer Living Better) Amendment (Review) Bill 2016
short_title: Aged Care (Living Longer Living Better) Amendment (Review) Bill 2016

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would require the government to review how residential aged care is funded.
The minister would arrange an independent review of the funding arrangements and the Aged Care Funding Instrument.
The bill would take effect on the day it receives royal assent.
changes: Adds a review of residential aged care funding to the existing independent review requirements.
Requires the review to consider the Aged Care Funding Instrument.
Empowers the minister to cause the review.
summary.affected: Older Australians and providers of residential aged care.

speeches.speaker: Anthony Albanese
speeches.brief: The speaker requested a later hour to present the Aged Care (Living Longer Living Better) Amendment (Review) Bill 2016, citing weather-related flight delays from Tasmania that prevented Tasmanian representatives from attending.
